message.content: A delivery means taking a drone with a load from one site to another. I’m responsible for picking the right drone—one that can carry the load, reach the destination, and return safely. I also need to make sure the drone’s battery lasts for the whole trip, and that the sites it’s flying between have space for it to take off and land. The load’s ready or not, and the drone’s arrival are things I can’t control, so I just wait for those updates to come through.
